name: Eleven-State Endpoint-Root Sharpness Example
definition: On $X=\{1,2,3,4\}$, take $\mathcal L_{11}=\{\varnothing,1,2,12,13,23,123,124,134,234,1234\}$, where strings abbreviate subsets.
properties: This is an accessible union-closed learning space with eleven states. It contains the antipodal pair $1,234$, but neither member of that pair is a valid learning-space root. It proves the ten-state endpoint-root bound is sharp.
